instruction: Candid action photograph of a dance studio with dark walls and a wooden floor. In the center, the man in the rust-colored shirt (R1) balances dynamically on one leg, body tilted, holding the hand of the woman in the mustard yellow shirt (R2) who is mostly out of frame on the right. In the background, three bystander dancers in matching rust and yellow shirts perform coordinated movements. Soft overhead lighting illuminates the warm wood floor.

R3 and R4 are background bystander dancers performing coordinated movements rather than the main hand-contact pair

the wooden floor is the surface under the dancing action
